{{Asof|June 2026}}, the [[Lufthansa Group]] announced that it would terminate its Newcastle to [[Frankfurt Airport|Frankfurt]] services, while continuing Eurowings services to Berlin and Düsseldorf. This was part of a wider adjustment to Lufthansa's 2026 summer schedule. Lufthansa said that background to this decision was the discontinuation of [[Lufthansa Cityline]] and the need to reduce economically unviable routes, due to high fuel prices.
